title: Full-Stack Web Development
tagline: Fast web apps and APIs with React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
summary: End-to-end web work by Shahan Ali (PROBOY): semantic frontends, accessible UI, Node.js backends, and clean deployment.
overview: Modern web apps need clean components, predictable state, and fast first renders. So I build with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, paired with Node.js APIs and MySQL or Firestore.
Every build uses semantic HTML, keyboard-friendly navigation, and technical SEO. As a result, pages load fast and stay easy to keep.
deliverables: Node.js REST APIs and database integration
Responsive UI, technical SEO, and clean deployment
idealFor: Founders and teams who need a custom web app, a dashboard, or a fast marketing site with clean, readable code.

title: WhatsApp Bot Development & Automation
tagline: Node.js WhatsApp bots with commands, pairing-code setup, and automation.
summary: Custom WhatsApp automation built on Node.js and Baileys by the creator of ProBoy-MD.
overview: I also build and maintain ProBoy-MD, a WhatsApp Multi-Device bot with 224 commands. So I know how bots behave under real chat load.
Each system uses modular command routers, pairing-code login, and clean API hooks. That means every command stays isolated and easy to audit.
deliverables: Custom Node.js and Baileys WhatsApp bot
Prefix commands with aliases and role permissions
Auto-replies, order alerts, and webhook triggers
Group tools and cloud hosting on Render or a VPS
idealFor: Businesses and communities that want to automate replies, notifications, or group tasks on WhatsApp.

title: Shopify Development
tagline: Custom Shopify themes and Liquid sections for fast, trusted stores. For example, cart drawers and product filters.
summary: Shopify Online Store 2.0 development by Shahan Ali (PROBOY) — Liquid, speed, and clean mobile UX.
overview: Good Shopify work balances design with speed. So I build inside Online Store 2.0 and Liquid, with lean sections and no bloated scripts.
For example, I add product filters, slide-out carts, and checkout upgrades. In addition, I wire inventory and order webhooks when needed.
deliverables: Shopify Online Store 2.0 sections and Liquid templates
Mobile-first product pages and slide-out cart drawer
Collection filters and storefront speed tuning
idealFor: Brands launching or upgrading a Shopify store for better mobile UX and faster page loads.

title: AI Integrations & Automation
tagline: AI features that solve real problems. For example, Gemini assistants in web apps and WhatsApp bots.
summary: Applied AI engineering with Google Gemini APIs and Node.js / React interfaces.
overview: I add AI where it solves a real problem. For example, chat assistants inside WhatsApp bots, content helpers in admin tools, and structured automation in web apps.
In practice, each integration includes input checks, error handling, and clear fallbacks when an API fails.
deliverables: Google Gemini API integration for web apps and Node.js
AI chat and command helpers inside WhatsApp bots
Structured prompts, validation, and safe fallbacks
idealFor: Teams who want reliable Gemini AI assistants or automated workflows inside existing web apps or chat.
